How FailUp works
  1. Step 1

    Find a weight where you fail on the last few reps of your last set

  2. Step 2

    Set a goal to do all of those reps without failing

  3. Step 3

    Reach that goal, increase the weight, and fail some more

That’s failing upward

It’s also called progressive overload

Features

Built for the gym floor

Fast to log between sets, easy to read at a glance, made by someone who trains with it

The smoothest logging in the App Store

FailUp was built to let you keep focus on the workout. Track the weight and reps for every set, along with the effort you put in

Overload Tracker

Watch your goals climb

The sweet spot for muscle growth is when you fail in the last few reps of your last set. Complete every rep of every set with your goal weight, and a new goal is set, so you can fail some more

Workout plans

Build a plan around your week

Pick how many days your split runs, drop in your workouts and rest days, and set the dates. FailUp tells you what’s up today and counts you through the block

Live workout

Keep focused, push towards your goals

If you are on track to reach your goal during a workout, we show you. Purple is the color of earned failure, and it lights the way

Saved equipment

Save specific equipment to track with accuracy

Tie your goals to specific equipment to ensure your goals are right where they need to be

Every gym you train at

Home, downtown, travel, each with its own equipment and defaults

Rest timer

A countdown between sets that opens your next set when time’s up

Plans and progress

Failures earned, goals reached and how far you are through your block

502 exercises

Search by name or filter by muscle and equipment, or create your own

Backups

Your whole history in one file, restore it on a new phone in seconds

Users over profit

Buy once, use forever

FailUp is a passion project with a firm stance against hyper-monetization. The key metric is how happy our users are
